description:
Per-repo configuration for gha-doctor (.gha-doctor.yml, .gha-doctor.yaml, .github/gha-doctor.yml, or .github/gha-doctor.yaml). Explicit CLI flags always win over the file; --no-config ignores it entirely.
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/

cache-logs.description:
How many job logs to sample for real cache hit/miss rates; 0 disables (--cache-logs).
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/

anyOf.description:
MissingConcurrencyCancellation — PR-triggered workflow lacks a concurrency group with cancel-in-progress, so superseded runs keep burning minutes
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d001-missingconcurrencycancellation

NoJobTimeout — job has no timeout-minutes; a hung job bills the 6-hour default
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d002-nojobtimeout

UncachedSetupAction — setup-node/python/java without built-in dependency caching re-downloads packages every run
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d003-uncachedsetupaction

FullFetchDepth — checkout with fetch-depth: 0 clones full history on every run
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d004-fullfetchdepth

HighFrequencyCron — schedule runs very frequently; GitHub delays or drops high-frequency crons
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d005-highfrequencycron

ExpensiveRunnerOnEveryPush — macOS/Windows/large runner triggered on every push or PR (macOS bills 10x, Windows 2x)
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d006-expensiverunneroneverypush

DockerBuildWithoutLayerCache — docker build-push without cache-from/cache-to rebuilds all layers every run
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d007-dockerbuildwithoutlayercache

CacheWithoutRestoreKeys — actions/cache without restore-keys misses on every lockfile change
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d008-cachewithoutrestorekeys

ContinueOnErrorMasksFailures — continue-on-error hides real failures and wastes debugging time
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d009-continueonerrormasksfailures

DefaultArtifactRetention — artifacts keep the 90-day default retention and count against storage
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d010-defaultartifactretention

LargeMatrixOnPRs — large matrix runs in full on every PR
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d011-largematrixonprs

NpmInstallInCI — npm install in CI is slower and less reproducible than npm ci
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d012-npminstallinci

PushAndPullRequestDoubleRun — workflow triggers on both unscoped push and pull_request, running the same commit twice for every PR
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d013-pushandpullrequestdoublerun

TopOfHourCron — cron fires at minute 0, the peak-load window where GitHub delays or drops scheduled runs
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d014-topofhourcron

RetiredActionVersion — step uses an action version GitHub has shut down (artifact v1-v3, cache v1-v2); it fails at runtime
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d015-retiredactionversion

RetiredRunnerLabel — job requests a hosted runner label GitHub has retired; the job cannot run
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d016-retiredrunnerlabel

NoActionsUpdateAutomation — nothing updates the repo's action pins (no dependabot github-actions ecosystem, no renovate); they rot until they hit shut-down versions
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d017-noactionsupdateautomation

DeprecatedWorkflowCommand — run step emits a stdout workflow command GitHub has deprecated or disabled (set-env/add-path error at runtime; set-output/save-state warn on every run, removal announced)
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d018-deprecatedworkflowcommand

DeprecatedActionRuntime — action.yml declares runs.using node12/node16 (runtimes removed from runners) or node20 (deprecated; removal from runners announced for fall 2026) — declare node24
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d019-deprecatedactionruntime

DeprecatingRunnerLabel — job requests a hosted runner label with an announced retirement; brownouts start on the deprecation date and the job stops running on the removal date
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules#d020-deprecatingrunnerlabel

disable.description:
Rule IDs this repo has decided not to enforce: a list, or one comma-separated string. Unknown IDs are warned about and skipped.
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/rules

flaky-logs.description:
How many logs of proven-flaky failures to read to name the flaky tests; 0 disables (--flaky-logs).
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/

log-tail.description:
How many trailing lines of a failing step's log a --run deep dive shows; 0 disables (--log-tail).
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/

runs.description:
How many recent workflow runs the history analysis samples (--runs).
https://linnea-bakshi.github.io/gha-doctor/

title: gha-doctor configuration
